# Prague City Tourism

> > Official tourism portal for Prague, offering cultural heritage tours, architectural guides, memorial programs, and visitor services for exploring the Czech capital.

Prague City Tourism (prague.eu) serves as the official destination marketing organization for Prague, providing comprehensive visitor information, literary and historical walking tours, partner programs for hotels and tourism businesses, and specialized content exploring Prague's architectural heritage from Gothic to brutalist periods. The site features memorial bell-ringing events (zvony paměti), barrier-free accessibility guides, and the 'Fenomén Praha' cultural heritage initiative.

## Key Topics

- Prague City Tourism
- Fenomén Praha (Prague Phenomenon cultural program)
- Pražský chodec (Prague Walker tours)
- Zvony paměti (Memorial bells program)
- Prague architecture (1958-1989 brutalist era)
- Literary tours (Guillaume Apollinaire, Franz Kafka)
- Barrier-free accessibility
- Official City Partner program
- Prague Castle (Prager Burg)
- Jewish Quarter (židovská čtvrť)
- Old Town Square (Staroměstské náměstí)
- Vltava River (Moldau)
- WWII resistance history (Obrana národa)
- Pilgrimage routes
- VIP concierge services

## Visitor Information & Services

- [information](https://prague.eu/en/home/information): Tourist information hub with practical guides and emergency contacts
- [Prag ohne Barrieren — Unterkünfte](https://prague.eu/de/prahou-bez-barier-ubytovani-copy): Barrier-free accessible accommodation guide for wheelchair users in Prague
- [concierge](https://prague.eu/en/concierge): Exclusive VIP concierge services and private tours for luxury hotels

## Cultural Heritage & Walking Tours

- [fenomén praha](https://prague.eu/cs/fenomen-praha): Prague phenomenon exploring cultural heritage and famous figures like Kafka
- [staňte se pražským chodcem](https://prague.eu/cs/stante-se-prazskym-chodcem): Prague walker program featuring literary tours and historic landmarks
- [Pilgerwege](https://prague.eu/de/pilgerwege): Pilgrimage routes including St. Ludmilla Way through Prague region
- [Prague in Leaf and Bloom](https://prague.eu/en/prague-in-leaf-and-bloom): Guide to Prague's parks, gardens and green spaces including Stromovka

## Architecture & Urban Heritage

- [Architecture 58–89](https://prague.eu/en/architecture-58-89): Brutalist and socialist architecture in Prague from 1958-1989 era
- [Architecture 1958–89: National Assembly](https://prague.eu/en/architecture-1958-89-national-assembly): Karel Prager's brutalist National Assembly building from 1966-1974
- [das Geheimnis der Prager Hauszeichen](https://prague.eu/de/das-geheimnis-der-prager-hauszeichen): History of Prague house signs in Kleinseite and Hradschin districts
- [mladší sestra eiffelovy věže](https://prague.eu/cs/mladsi-sestra-eiffelovy-veze): Petřín Lookout Tower, Prague's steel replica of the Eiffel Tower

## Memorial Programs & History

- [Zvonili jsme za Vladimíra Rajnocha: 4. 9. 2024 v 15:00](https://prague.eu/cs/zvonime-za-vladimira-rajnocha-4-9-2024-v-1500): Memorial bell ringing for anti-communist resistance fighter Vladimír Rajnoch
- [Zvonili jsme za gen. Josefa Zmeka: 8. 7. 2025 v 15:00](https://prague.eu/cs/zvonime-za-gen-josefa-zmeka-8-7-2025-v-1500): Memorial event for General Josef Zmek, Russian Legion and WWII veteran
- [Zvonili jsme za Metoděje Kubáně: 5. 3. 2024 v 15:00](https://prague.eu/cs/zvonime-za-metodeje-kubane-5-3-2024-v-1500): Memorial for military chaplain Metoděj Kubáň, Dachau victim and WWI veteran
- [Zvonili jsme za Josefa Chrudimského: 10. 11. 2024 v 15:00](https://prague.eu/cs/zvonime-za-josefa-chrudimskeho-10-11-2024-v-1500): Memorial bell ringing for WWII resistance fighter Josef Chrudimský

## Literary & Cultural Content

- [básně o praze — výběr 54.](https://prague.eu/cs/fenomen-praha-2/basne-o-praze/basne-o-praze-vyber-54): Poetry collection about Prague by Marie Iljašenko and Petr Borkovec

## Partner Programs

- [official city partner](https://prague.eu/en/home/for-partners/official-city-partner): Official City Partner program for hotel and tourism B2B collaboration
